info.title: Gizra Vendor API
info.description: Vendor web panel and POS endpoints

tags.name: Vendor Orders (Web Panel & POS)
tags.description: Marketplace order APIs shared by the Restaurant Web Panel (vendor.gizra.app) and the Vendor POS app. Authenticate with POST /vendor/login (Bearer JWT). Lists consumer-placed orders only (excludes order_type=pos counter sales). POS uses the same endpoints for live orders, status updates, and FCM new_order payloads after POST /consumer/order/place.
